qualification: This is a read-only causal advisory on one retained failed OpenCode TEST-peer UI flow. It accepts the failure accounting and identifies a narrowly supported harness correction shape. It does not accept a source postimage, approve controls, authorize execution, prove the proposed fix, or qualify any native provider.

executiveFinding.certain: The original driver failed inside the initial readPoint for 'open original member detail', before any member-detail hover or mouse press/release. The custom expression never supplied an accepted target before the original 30000ms read window ended. Earlier UI prefix evidence remains real but the overall receipt and job are failed/incomplete.
executiveFinding.concreteSourceDefect: The driver asks for the viewport-hit-testable center of the exact Alice name without first revealing that name. clickExpression does not scroll. The member roster is above Kanban in a separately scrollable main panel. The retained failure image shows that panel scrolled into Kanban, with the member roster and team header outside the visible area.
executiveFinding.supportedInference: Omitted viewport preparation is the leading source-backed explanation and a concrete robustness defect in this harness flow. An offscreen or clipped name center fails elementFromPoint/descendant eligibility indefinitely while the underlying roster can be ready.
executiveFinding.notProven: The selected custom expression returns only null on all refusal paths. The receipt does not contain failed row/name counts, rectangles, clipping boundary, target center or hit identity. It therefore cannot prove that one particular DOM branch, rather than another unrecorded refusal or allowed transient context error, occurred on every read.
executiveFinding.narrowShape: Reveal the same unique Alice member-name target through the existing bounded physical scrollTo helper immediately before the unchanged clickExpression. Preserve target identity, unique-row/name checks, nested-button exclusion, hit ownership, post-hover stabilization, final ownership/geometry checks and one press/release. No timeout increase, blind click, action retry, direct handler/store/API invocation, selector relaxation or product component change is supported.
